reviews.comment: I have no idea how I did well in this class. I could not understand a single word Miwa said. 50 minutes went by really slow when you cant understand the professor so I stopped going. Before you stop going to the class get in a good group where someone attends class at everytime. I have no idea how I passed let alone made an A

Miwa's class could be overcomplicated, but decent. Lectures are dull, but take notes because you will have a lot of mini-assignments to use them on. Stay on top of research project timeline she has set for success. Most importantly, USE THE TEXTBOOK TO STUDY! The 2 exams in class are heavy, and the book is the only way to get a good grade.
The class has 4 speeches, 1 exam, and some classwork. Speech grading is very tough. Other than the tough grading, Professor Ito is a nice person.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Ito cares about her class. However, she is not a good professor. Her lectures are very poorly explained, and her accent is very hard to interpret. She grades tough on speeches, and her grading can be inconsistent. Be prepared to go above and beyond in some areas to get an A. Way too much work for a core required class.

Prof. Ito is such a lovely and caring professor, but her lectures were not very engaging and were difficult to understand because of her accent. She is not a tough grader, which helped out a lot in the projects, but I still would consider other options. If you do choose to take this course with Prof. Ito, CHOOSE A GOOD GROUP FOR THE PROJECTS!

Whole class is based on group projects -- get a good group. Assignments are scaled leniently so if you do the bare minimum you're fine. Lectures are very slow and inefficient and just repeat the textbook. Not worth attending lectures -- just read the book and take notes. Exams are open-resource. Easy class.

Miwa was super sweet, but unfortunately her lectures were long, winding, and repetitive. Assignments were easy and fair, but I highly recommend reading the textbook if you want to pass exams. She really does care and want everyone to pass, but teaching just isn't her calling.

Go to her office hours religiously. Only reason why I got an A. She will let you practice your whole speech and give you specific feedback. She is a tough critic though and will you tell you exactly what she thinks. Going to her zoom office hours saved me. This class took more time than it needed though.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Miwa is a nice lady but omg shes a horrible prof. I had a small class w/ 20 people and im telling you everyone in that class would be concerned with how she explained things. The speeches were horrible and she gave us no time to practice in front of ppl and her grading was so weird for no reason and talk about the anxiety from this class.

Miwa is so kind, and she really cares. I would highly recommend attending her office hours consistently if need be. She is always there to help. Her grading can be tough but if you work with her, you can understand her expectations better and improve. The goal should be progress on each speech you give, and the grades will come too.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Miwa is very kind and willing to help. If you take advantage of office hours and ask questions she will provide relevant feedback. While I was expecting it to be easier and less work, this class did teach me a lot about public speaking and how to effectively/confidently convey a message to an audience.

Miwa is hard to understand and is hard to communicate with. Throughout the entire course I was not sure what was expected of me or if I was properly taking care of assignments. I learned very little about public speaking and overall there was not a welcoming feel that you would expect from a class like this. A lot of busy work. I don't recommend.

Miwa is very sweet, but this class is just made to be difficult. You are only allowed a few note cards when you speak, and that plus her strict grading criteria and high expectations make it VERY hard to get an A on the speeches. There is also textbook reading before every class that only shows up on the final exam. LOTS of work for this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Miwa is very passionate about teaching, but she is also a very tough grader. Attendance is mandatory, you are allowed 3 absences, but any more than that and your grade will drop by 10% for each one. This class is very fast-paced, as soon as you finish one speech you start the next (a total of 4 speeches, including 2 as a group.) Go to office hours!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader
